title: Agentic RAG
sub: The model runs its own searches and decides when it has enough.

steps.d:
"How long is the warranty on the DW-480,
and what voids it?"

3 passages. They give the length: two years.
They say nothing about what voids it.

steps.h: The model searches again with a different query
steps.d:
thinking: the results cover length, not exclusions.
→ search("DW-480 warranty exclusions void")
2 passages. Both point to §9.2 without quoting it.

steps.h: The model opens the full section
The model decides it has enough information
steps.d:
"Two years from delivery [§9]. Void if installed
without the anti-tip bracket, run on a generator
without a line conditioner, or serviced by an
unlisted technician [§9.2]."

climb: Four model calls instead of one, about four times the tokens, and about three times the wait. In return it found the third exclusion that RAG missed.

use.p: This is what the deep research features in chat apps do. The model runs its own searches, reads the results, decides whether it has enough, and searches again if not. It costs more and takes longer, so use it for questions that need several searches.

build.code:
tools = [search, read]
msgs  = [user(question)]
while True:
    out = model.complete(msgs, tools=tools)  # the model chooses the next step
    if not out.tool_calls:
        break                                 # the model chooses when to stop
    msgs += run(out.tool_calls)
